caption: Figure 8.3: Total-Field / Scattered-Field plane-wave excitation (wakis.tfsf.TFSFSource). Left: a Huygens box partitions the grid into an interior Total-Field (TF) region containing the scatterer and an exterior Scattered-Field (SF) region containing only outgoing scattered waves. Right: instead of evaluating E_inc(x, t) = s(t − x/c) analytically (which leaks 10⁻³–10⁻² because v_p(ω) ≠ c on the 3D grid), TFSFSource advances a 1D auxiliary FIT line sharing the 3D grid's exact cell lengths (grid.L, grid.tL) and applies the discrete commutator correction on the Huygens faces, reducing empty-box leakage to round-off (≲ 10⁻¹⁵).
visual_intent:
Textbook-quality scientific schematic for a computational electromagnetics user manual. Flat vector style on a white background, high contrast, thin dark outlines, generous whitespace, sans-serif labels. Colour code used in every figure: primary grid G and its quantities in blue, dual grid G-tilde and its quantities in orange, exact/topological items in dark grey, approximate/material items in green, failure or warning items in red. Colourblind-safe. Every label must be spelled exactly as listed in this brief; mathematical symbols must be typeset correctly (hats, tildes, subscripts, transposes). Do not add any number, value, equation, software name, product name, logo, watermark or title that is not listed in this brief. Prefer fewer, larger labels over many small ones. No 3D photorealism, no cartoon characters, no hand-drawn or xkcd style.

Two panels side by side. LEFT PANEL (heading 'TFSFSource Huygens Box'): a 2D cross-section of a 3D grid surrounded by outer absorbing walls. Inside the grid, draw a dashed green square labelled 'Huygens box: size=(2.4e-6, 2.4e-6, 2.4e-6)'. Shade the interior of the square light blue, containing a circular scatterer in 'background_eps_r=1.0' and vertical wavefront bars moving right with arrow 'direction="+x", polarization="z"', labelled 'Total-Field (TF) region: E_tot = E_inc + E_sca'. Leave the exterior ring between the Huygens box and the outer boundary white with faint outgoing ripples from the scatterer, labelled 'Scattered-Field (SF) region: E_sca only'. At the bottom of the left panel, compare two badges: red badge 'analytical E_inc = s(t − x/c): leaks 10⁻³–10⁻² (since v_p(ω) ≠ c)' vs green badge 'Wakis 1D auxiliary FIT line: empty-box leakage ≲ 10⁻¹⁵ (round-off)'. RIGHT PANEL (heading 'Exact Discrete Commutator Injection'): top shows a 2D slice of the 3D grid along +x (including graded cell widths), and directly underneath it a 1D auxiliary FIT line with matching primary edge lengths 'grid.L' (blue) and dual edge lengths 'grid.tL' (orange) carrying 'e_inc, h_inc'. Vertical green arrows connect the 1D auxiliary line to the left and right faces of the Huygens box. Below the diagram, display the two exact commutator update equations from line 1592: 'H += −Δt (M_h A − A M_e) e_inc' and 'E += Δt (M_e B − B M_h) h_inc'.
